title: Pan Con Crema Catalana
description: A Spanish twist on the classic dessert with a creamy twist. A rich and creamy crema catalana pairs perfectly with the elegance of toasted bread.

ingredients.name: Bread
ingredients.notes: Elegant bread, preferably a crusty baguette

ingredients.name: Catalan Cream
ingredients.notes: Optional, adds an extra layer of flavor

instructions: 2. Slice the bread into 1-inch thick slices and toast until crispy.
3. In a small saucepan, heat the crema catalana over low heat until warmed through.
4. To assemble the dessert, place a toasted bread slice on a plate and drizzle with the warmed crema catalana.
5. If desired, top with a dollop of catalan cream.
